applies_to.quote: The provisions of these Directions shall apply to all authorised non-bank PSOs.
Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS) Operators, Bharat Bill Payment Operating Units (BBPOUs) and Payment Aggregators (PAs) are considered as large non-bank PSOs.
Categorisation of authorised non-bank PPI Issuers into small, medium and large is as per the Oversight Framework
White label ATM Operators (WLAOs) managing their ATM Switch ecosystem through shared services of third party ATM Switch Application Service Providers (ASPs)

answer.action: Non-bank payment system operators must comply with consolidated master directions on cyber resilience, digital payment security controls, and system audits.
answer.action_quote: The provisions of these Directions shall apply to all authorised non-bank PSOs.

effective_date.quote: The Directions shall come into effect on the day they are placed on the official website of the RBI for Large and Medium non-bank PSOs.

comply_by.quote: For small non-bank PSOs, the directions shall come into effect from April 01, 2028.
